texts.as_from_device: Kuphendulwe kule divayisi, kusukela kusizo olugcinwe ngo-{date}.
texts.as_no_answer: Ayikho impendulo kule divayisi. Buza futhi uma usu-inthanethi, noma uxoxe nomuntu.
texts.as_why_confirm: Hlola imininingwane, bese uqinisekisa noma wenqabe.
texts.as_why_hand_over: Umuntu noma uzakwethu onelayisensi uyena onquma lokhu, ngakho kulungiselelwe bona.
texts.as_why_later: Lokhu kudinga inethiwekhi nomuntu noma uzakwethu. Kuzolungiswa kuthunyelwe uma usuku-inthanethi.
texts.as_why_network: Lokhu kuthinta i-akhawunti yakho, ngakho kulinde inethiwekhi.
texts.as_why_not_registered: I-LynkAssist ayikwazi ukwenza lokhu. Akukhona okuvunyelwe ukukwenza.
texts.as_why_role: Indima yakho ayikuvumeli lokhu. Buza umnikazi.
texts.as_why_unknown: Angikwazi lokhu. Nansi indawo ongathola khona.
texts.case_opened: Icala losizo livuliwe. Izimpendulo zizofika kuZingxoxo.
texts.emk_disconnected_body: I-{emulator} icishiwe kule divayisi. Cela umphathi wakho ukuthi ayixhume.
texts.emk_home_body: Engeza i-{name} esikrinini sasekhaya ukuze uyivule ngokuthinta kanye.
texts.emk_hw_another: Le divayisi ayikwazi ukuyixhuma. Phrinta noma uthwebule ngenye idivayisi esikhundleni salokho.
texts.emk_hw_note: Ihadiwe engekho noma ephukile ayilokothi imise umsebenzi wakho: i-emulator isebenzisa inguqulo yayo eyakhelwe ngaphakathi.
texts.emk_hw_ways: Izindlela ezisebenza kule divayisi, engcono kuqala:
texts.emk_lost_body: Imakwe njengelahlekile. Umphathi wakho angayivula uma isitholakele.
texts.emk_no_vibration: Le divayisi ayikwazi ukudlidliza, ngakho idlala umsindo kuphela.
texts.emk_pin_same: Zonke izinkinobho ze-PIN zenza umsindo ofanayo.
texts.emk_practice_body: Idatha yokuzijwayeza kuphela. Akukho lutho lapha olungokoqobo noma olubalwayo.
texts.emk_quiet: Imisindo icishiwe kumodi ethulile noma ngamahora okuthula.
texts.emk_reapproval_body: Le divayisi ayibonakalanga isikhashana. Cela umphathi wakho ukuthi ayivumele futhi.
texts.emk_refused_no_way_to_use: Le divayisi ayinaso isikrini sokuthinta futhi ayinazo izinkinobho.
texts.emk_request_body: U-{by} ufuna ukuxhuma i-{emulator} kule divayisi.
texts.emk_send_note: Ikhophi ephrintiwe nekhophi yedijithali yidokhumenti efanayo.
texts.emk_tones_manager_kiosk: Isikrini samakhasimende silandela isilungiselelo somphathi wakho.
texts.emk_way_round_connect_a_scanner: Xhuma isithwebuli, noma usebenzise idivayisi enekhamera.
texts.emk_way_round_use_remote_or_keyboard: Sebenzisa irimothi noma ikhibhodi kulesi sikrini.
texts.emp_branch_only: Umphathi wegatsha ubona igatsha lakhe kuphela.
texts.emp_cheaper: I-{tier} manje ishibhile kunohlelo lwakho uma unala madivayisi angeziwe.
texts.emp_code_once: Thwebula ikhodi ye-QR, vula isixhumanisi noma uthayiphe ikhodi kudivayisi. Isebenza kanye, imizuzu engu-{m}.
texts.emp_count_rule: Kubalwa kuphela izikrini zabasebenzi ezisetshenziswayo. Indawo yokukhokha esebenzisa amasevisi amaningi ibalwa kanye.
texts.emp_day_pass_note: Usuku olumatasa noma umcimbi? Iphasi losuku lingeza idivayisi eyodwa yabasebenzi usuku olulodwa, kuze kube izinsuku ezingu-{days} zilandelana.
texts.emp_extra_plus_pro: Amadivayisi angeziwe anyanga zonke aza ne-Plus ne-Pro; i-Max ayinamkhawulo.
texts.emp_history_note: Umuntu ngamunye ubona umlando wakhe ku-akhawunti yakhe. Indawo eboniswayo yigatsha.
texts.emp_intro: Nikeza ifoni, ithebulethi, ikhompyutha, ikhiyoski noma isibonisi isikrini, bese ubona idivayisi ngayinye bukhoma.
texts.emp_other_ways: Idivayisi ingacela nokujoyina, noma ikhethwe ngegama uma yake yasetshenziswa.
texts.emp_owner_manager_only: Umnikazi noma umphathi kuphela ongakwenza lokhu.
texts.emp_pin_same: Umsindo ofanayo kuyo yonke inkinobho ye-PIN
texts.emp_reason_no_way_to_use: Leyo divayisi ayinaso isikrini sokuthinta futhi ayinazo izinkinobho.
texts.emp_reason_plan_limit: Uhlelo lwakho lugcwele. Nqamula idivayisi eyodwa noma wengeze eyodwa.
texts.emp_view_failed: Hhayi manje: kunenkokhelo, ukubala, isiginesha noma i-PIN esikrinini.
texts.emp_why_printer: Iphrinta ayinalo iphepha noma lisele kancane.
texts.find_or_do_hint: Sesha imikhiqizo, amakhasimende, ama-oda, imibiko, izilungiselelo nosizo, noma uthayiphe isenzo
texts.kp_state_queued: Kugcinwe kule divayisi futhi kulinde ukuthunyelwa.
texts.match_ok: Izinombolo ziyafana. Le divayisi manje ingasetshenziswa.
texts.match_pick_note: Uma ingekho inombolo efanayo, yima: kungenzeka omunye umuntu uzama ukungena.
texts.match_show_note: Umuntu osedivayisini entsha uthinta inombolo efanayo.
texts.msg_never_ask: I-LynkOmni ayikaze icele iphasiwedi yakho, amakhodi noma inombolo yekhadi ngomlayezo.
texts.msg_no_tracking: Asilandeleli ukuthi uyayivula yini imilayezo yethu.
texts.needs_net: Kudinga ukuxhumana: izicelo zenkokhelo nokuthumela izingxoxo.
texts.ntf_basis_opt_in: Ukhethe ukuthola lokhu. Ungakumisa noma nini.
texts.ntf_basis_safety: Kungenzeka othile usengozini, ngakho kuhlala kuthunyelwa.
texts.ntf_basis_security: Kumayelana nokuphepha kwe-akhawunti yakho, ngakho kuhlala kuthunyelwa.
texts.ntf_cannot_turn_off: Lolu hlobo alukwazi ukuvalwa, ngoba luyakuvikela wena noma abanye.
texts.pin_locked: Le divayisi ikhiyiwe ngemuva kokufaka i-PIN engalungile kaningi.
texts.pin_locked_how: Akukho okususiwe. Yivule ngekhodi yakho yokubuyisela, kusukela kwenye idivayisi ongene kuyo, noma ngokubuyisela i-akhawunti yakho ku-inthanethi.
texts.pin_wait: I-PIN ayilungile. Zama futhi emizuzwaneni engu-{s}.
texts.pin_wrong: I-PIN ayilungile. Kusele imizamo engu-{n} ngaphambi kokuthi idivayisi ikhiywe.
texts.ppl_after_payment_help: Kuboniswa esikrinini sekhasimende ngemuva kokuqinisekiswa kwenkokhelo. Ukuthinta okukodwa, akuphoqelekile neze.
texts.ppl_at_agree_full_id_number: Noma thayipha inombolo kamazisi ephelele (hhayi i-IDCN)
texts.ppl_at_agree_text: Ngiyavuma izindlela ezisoqoqweni lwami. Ukunika noma ubani i-PIN noma i-IDCN yami, noma ukungenisa omunye umuntu, kuwukukhohlisa ngokuba khona.
texts.ppl_at_already_in: Usungenile kakade. Cindezela Phuma uma usuhamba.
texts.ppl_at_backup_face_failed: Ubuso buhlulekile, ngakho kusetshenziswe indlela elandelayo.
texts.ppl_at_backup_face_not_working: Ubuso abusebenzi kule divayisi, ngakho kusetshenziswe indlela elandelayo.
texts.ppl_at_backup_finger_not_working: Umunwe awusebenzi kule divayisi, ngakho kusetshenziswe indlela elandelayo.
texts.ppl_at_bill_note: Kubalwa kuphela abantu abangene okungenani kanye kule nyanga. Izivakashi zimahhala.
texts.ppl_at_cert_note: Noma ubani angahlola ukuthi isitifiketi singokoqobo ngekhodi yaso.
texts.ppl_at_checker_note: Abantu abathenjwayo abasendaweni. Umuntu akalokothi abone igama lakhe ohlwini.
texts.ppl_at_clock_note: Uma idivayisi ixhuma ku-inthanethi inewashi elingalungile, amarekhodi ayo ayamakwa ukuze uwalungise.
texts.ppl_at_correct_note: Ukulungisa kugcina irekhodi elidala eduze kwelisha.
texts.ppl_at_device_limit: Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa amadivayisi omnyango angu-{n}.
texts.ppl_at_event_limit: Lolu hlelo selufinyelele inani lalo lemicimbi.
texts.ppl_at_fire_note: Wonke umuntu ongaphakathi, abasebenzi nezivakashi, ukuze bamakwe endaweni yokuhlangana. Kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
texts.ppl_at_flag_note: Lezi yizimpawu nje, azisona neze isimangalo. Nguwe onqumayo.
texts.ppl_at_group_note: Igatsha elilodwa noma umcimbi owodwa yiqembu elilodwa le-PIN. I-PIN ayinikezwa kabili futhi ayiphinde isetshenziswe.
texts.ppl_at_group_warn: Leli qembu le-PIN selicishe ligcwele. Qala iqembu elisha le-PIN.
texts.ppl_at_hand_note: Kuphela uma zonke izindlela zihlulekile. Isizathu siyaqoshwa njalo, futhi awusoze wazingenisa wena.
texts.ppl_at_id_mismatch: Leyo akuyona inombolo kamazisi ephelele eseqophweni.
texts.ppl_at_limit: Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa abantu abangu-{n}. Khetha uhlelo olukhulu ukuze wengeze abanye.
texts.ppl_at_lock_note: Idivayisi ekhiyiwe ayisakwazi ukungenisa muntu. Konke okukuyo kubethelwe.
texts.ppl_at_needs_online: Lokhu kudinga i-inthanethi. Kuzosebenza uma uxhumano selubuyile.
texts.ppl_at_no_check_out_rule: Irekhodi elisavulekile emahoreni angu-2 ngemva kokuphela kweshifu (phakathi kwamabili uma engekho amashifu) limakwa ngokuthi "Akuphumanga". Umuntu uyakhunjuzwa bese wena ulungisa isikhathi.
texts.ppl_at_only_added: Yidivayisi yomnyango oyengezile kuphela engangenisa abantu.
texts.ppl_at_pin_note: I-LynkOmni idala i-PIN. Akekho oyithayiphayo noma oyikhethayo.
texts.ppl_at_reader_needed: Kudingeka isifundi seminwe salo muntu. Xhuma isifundi seminwe kule divayisi ukuze uqhubeke.
texts.ppl_at_req_note: Uyakhunjuzwa ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-7, 14 no-25. Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-30 kungenzwanga lutho, imininingwane izisula ngokwayo.
texts.ppl_at_sandbox_clock: Indawo yokuhlola: iwashi lale divayisi alilungile
texts.ppl_at_sandbox_delete: Indawo yokuhlola: umuntu ucela ukuthi kusulwe imininingwane yakhe
texts.ppl_at_sandbox_late: Indawo yokuhlola: sekungamahora angu-2 ngemva kweshifu
texts.ppl_at_send_note: I-PIN ne-IDCN kuhamba ndawonye, kuya kuphela kumuntu uqobo.
texts.ppl_at_set_note: Iqoqo likhethwa ngemvume yomuntu. Wonke umuntu une-IDCN njengesipele.
texts.ppl_at_show_note: Njalo uma i-PIN iboniswa noma ithunyelwa kuyaqoshwa.
texts.ppl_at_too_few: Lo mazisi unezinombolo ezimbalwa kakhulu. Sicela ubhalisele lo muntu omunye umazisi.
texts.ppl_at_visitor_needed: Thayipha igama lesivakashi bese ukhetha lowo esimvakashele.
texts.ppl_at_visitor_note: Hlola umazisi wesivakashi. Akuthathwa sithombe. Uma engekho umazisi, umphathi kumele avumele ukuvakasha.
texts.ppl_checker_notice: Sicela uqiniseke ukuthi umhloli omkhethayo ukhona endaweni.
texts.ppl_codes_left: Izinombolo zamathikithi ezingu-{n} zilungile kule divayisi
texts.ppl_door_blocked: I-PIN yakho imisiwe okwesikhashana. Umphathi angasiza.
texts.ppl_door_offline: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Igcinwa kule divayisi bese ithunyelwa lapho uxhumano lubuya.
texts.ppl_door_paused: Imizamo miningi kakhulu. Sicela ulinde umzuzu noma ubone umphathi.
texts.ppl_door_pin_wrong: Leyo PIN ayaziwa lapha. Sicela uzame futhi.
texts.ppl_good_share: U-{share}% uthe kuhle noma kuhle kakhulu, ngomehluko wamaphuzu angu-{margin}.
texts.ppl_idcn_wrong: I-IDCN yakho ayifani. Kusele imizamo engu-{n}.
texts.ppl_owner_manager_only: Umnikazi noma umphathi kuphela ongangeza idivayisi.
texts.ppl_pair_code: Kudivayisi entsha, vula i-LynkOmni bese uthayipha le khodi:
texts.ppl_pair_note: Ikhodi isebenza kanye futhi iphelelwa yisikhathi ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-10.
texts.ppl_priority: Okubalulekile: umuntu omdala, okhulelwe noma onokukhubazeka
texts.ppl_qu_balance: Umuntu ongu-1 obekwa phambili ngemva kwabanye abangu-{n}.
texts.ppl_qu_balance_help: Ukubekwa phambili kungokwabantu abadala, abantu abakhubazekile, abesifazane abakhulelwe nezimo eziphuthumayo.
texts.ppl_qu_bill_note: Kubalwa kuphela indawo ekhiphe okungenani ithikithi elilodwa kule nyanga. Ukuvakasha okusebenzisa Thumela ku kuyithikithi elilodwa.
texts.ppl_qu_busiest: Ihora elimatasa kakhulu namuhla: {from} kuya ku-{to}.
texts.ppl_qu_check_note: Lokhu kuwuphawu nje, akusona neze isimangalo. Umphathi nguye onqumayo.
texts.ppl_qu_check_priority: Ukubekwa phambili kusetshenziswa kaningi kakhulu lapha kunakwabanye.
texts.ppl_qu_check_put_back: Buyisela kulayini kusetshenziswa kaningi kakhulu lapha kunakwabanye.
texts.ppl_qu_check_scan: Skena ikhodi ye-QR yethikithi noma uthayiphe inombolo yalo.
texts.ppl_qu_close_help: Amathikithi asalindile ayavalwa bese emakwa ngokuthi "Akasizwanga namuhla". Ithikithi ngelanamuhla kuphela.
texts.ppl_qu_code_help: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu noma izinombolo ezingu-3, ngaphandle kuka-O, I, 0 noma 1. Isibonelo: LAB.
texts.ppl_qu_counter_order: Cindezela isigaba ukuze usengeze noma ususe. Isigaba sokuqala ohlwini sisizwa kuqala.
texts.ppl_qu_extra_tickets: Amathikithi angu-{n} ngaphezu kohlelo kule nyanga.
texts.ppl_qu_fair: Biza olandelayo kulandela uhlelo olunobulungiswa. Abasebenzi abalokothi bakhethe ukuthi ngubani olandelayo.
texts.ppl_qu_follow: Skena ukuze ulandele ulayini efonini yakho.
texts.ppl_qu_forecast_line: Kusasa kusukela ngo-{from} kuya ku-{to} kuzoba matasa e-{section}.
texts.ppl_qu_forecast_note: Kusuka ezinsukwini ezedlule zale ndawo uqobo.
texts.ppl_qu_free_limit: Amathikithi amahhala ale nyanga asephelile. Kudingeka uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_qu_health_note: Khetha ukuthi idivayisi ngayinye ibika ini.
texts.ppl_qu_history_note: Zonke izenzo ziyagcinwa. Amarekhodi awalokothi ashintshwe buthule.
texts.ppl_qu_join_only_help: Abantu baskena ikhodi ye-QR esesikrinini sokubiza. Ishintsha njalo ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa.
texts.ppl_qu_keeper_help: Idivayisi eyodwa esakhiweni igcina ulayini, ngakho ukulandelana kuhlala kulungile ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Wonke amanye amadivayisi ayayilandela.
texts.ppl_qu_keeper_none: Ayikho enye idivayisi engathatha umsebenzi manje. Engeza idivayisi yokwamukela noma yekhawunta ngesikhathi uxhumekile.
texts.ppl_qu_keeper_standby: Enye idivayisi eyengeziwe izithathela yona umsebenzi, inolayini ofanayo nezinombolo zayo zamathikithi.
texts.ppl_qu_late_help: Ngizofika sekwephuzile kukubuyisela emuva izindawo ezingu-{n}, kanye kuphela.
texts.ppl_qu_late_used: Ngizofika sekwephuzile sekusetshenzisiwe kakade kuleli thikithi.
texts.ppl_qu_msg_missed: Sikubize izikhathi ezingu-3. Cela indawo yokwamukela phakathi kwemizuzu engu-{m} ukuthi ikubuyisele kulayini.
texts.ppl_qu_no_codes: Le divayisi ayisenazo izinombolo zamathikithi. Xhuma ku-inthanethi ukuze uthole ezengeziwe.
texts.ppl_qu_no_display_note: Idivayisi engenaso isikrini yengezwa ngedivayisi exhunywe kuyo.
texts.ppl_qu_no_printer: Ayikho iphrinta eyengeziwe. Bonisa noma thumela inombolo yethikithi.
texts.ppl_qu_one_per_phone: Le foni isivele inethikithi elilindile lalesi sigaba.
texts.ppl_qu_only_here: Ungangena kulayini endaweni kuphela. Skena ikhodi ye-QR esesikrinini sokubiza.
texts.ppl_qu_phone_privacy: Inombolo yakho yefoni isetshenziselwa imilayezo yaleli thikithi kuphela futhi iyasulwa ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-30.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_counters: Uhlelo lwakho luvumela amakhawunta angu-{n} endaweni.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_forecast: Isibikezelo samahora amatasa sidinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_free: Uma umkhawulo usufinyelelwe, amathikithi aqhubeka esebenza kuze kuvalwe ngalolo suku. Kudingeka uhlelo olukhokhelwayo ngengxenye esele yenyanga.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_hardware: Amaphrinta, amakhiphedi, amapheja nezikena kudinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_line: Kusetshenziswe amathikithi angu-{used} kwangu-{included} kule nyanga.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_paid: Akekho ojikiswayo: amathikithi angu-1,000 engeziwe abiza {price}.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_sections: Uhlelo lwakho luvumela izigaba ezingu-{n} endaweni.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_send_to: Ukuthumela kwesinye isigaba kudinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_qu_plan_way: Le ndlela yokungena kulayini idinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_qu_public_help: Libonisa amathikithi asizwayo, bangaki abalindile nokuthi cishe kuzothatha isikhathi esingakanani. Izinombolo zamathikithi kuphela.
texts.ppl_qu_put_back_help: Ubuyela kulayini ngemva kwabantu abangu-{n} abalandelayo.
texts.ppl_qu_put_back_late: Sekudlule imizuzu engaphezu kwengu-{m}. Kudingeka ithikithi elisha.
texts.ppl_qu_qr_changes: Le khodi ishintsha njalo ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_by_email: Uhlelo lwakho lunemibiko ephelele, ethunyelwa nange-imeyili.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_custom: Uhlelo lwakho lunemibiko eyenziwe ngokwezifiso nokulanda okuphelele.
texts.ppl_qu_reports_full: Uhlelo lwakho lunemibiko ephelele ngesigaba, ikhawunta, umsebenzi nehora.
texts.ppl_qu_suggest_open: Ukulinda kwe-{section} sekudlule imizuzu engu-{m}. Kuvulwe elinye ikhawunta?
texts.ppl_qu_usual_busy: Kuvame ukuba matasa kusukela ngo-{from} kuya ku-{to}.
texts.ppl_qu_way_basic_phone: Shayela ikhodi emfushane noma uthumele umlayezo. Uthola umlayezo uma ithuba lakho selisondele.
texts.ppl_qu_way_lynkchat: Thumela "Sawubona" endaweni ku-LynkChat bese ukhetha isigaba.
texts.ppl_qu_way_smartphone: Vula isixhumanisi noma uskene ikhodi ye-QR esemnyango.
texts.ppl_reader_sandbox: Isifundi sokuhlola: khetha lokho isifundi esikubikayo.
texts.ppl_set_face_finger_idcn: Ubuso, bese kuba Umunwe, bese kuba i-IDCN
texts.ppl_setup_many_places_help: Amagatsha noma iminyango, ngayinye inezigaba namadivayisi ayo.
texts.ppl_setup_note: Ungakushintsha lokhu noma nini. Amanani, imikhawulo nemithetho kuhlala kufana.
texts.ppl_setup_one_place_help: Isitolo, ihhovisi noma indawo eyodwa enamadivayisi ayo.
texts.ppl_sv_after_help: Kusebenza kuphela uma ukuvula. Akekho obuzwa ngaphezu kwakanye ezinsukwini ezingu-30, futhi "Ungaphinde ungibuze" kuhlonishwa ngokushesha.
texts.ppl_sv_alert: Izimpendulo ezingagculisekile ezingu-{n}. Umphathi unquma okufanele kwenziwe.
texts.ppl_sv_anonymous_line: Le nhlolovo ayidaluli muntu. Igama lakho nenombolo yakho akukaze kuboniswe inhlangano.
texts.ppl_sv_approval_help: Inhlolovo iqala ngokuya kumgunyazi, ochofoza Gunyaza noma Buyisela nenothi. Akukho okufika emphakathini ngaphandle kokugunyazwa.
texts.ppl_sv_balanced_help: Kulinganiswe ukuze kufane nenani labantu langempela. Yomibili imiphumela iboniswa njalo.
texts.ppl_sv_cb_help: Umuntu ongagculisekile oshiye indlela yokuxhumana futhi wanikeza imvume uyashayelwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe.
texts.ppl_sv_check_help: Ukuhlolwa kokucaca: lungisa imibuzo emakiwe ngenguqulo engathathi hlangothi. Umbuzo obucayi uqala ngokucela imvume ecacile yomuntu.
texts.ppl_sv_check_never: Kuwuphawu nje, akukaze kube yisisolo. Akukho okusulwayo.
texts.ppl_sv_consent_line: {org} ibuza imibuzo engu-{n}. Cishe imizuzu engu-{m}.
texts.ppl_sv_creators_help: Kubalwa kuphela abadali abadale noma abathumele inhlolovo kule nyanga. Abafundi, abagunyazi, ababuzi basensimini nabaphendulayo bamahhala.
texts.ppl_sv_devices_help: Amadivayisi owengezile kuphela aqoqa izimpendulo endaweni. Idivayisi elahlekile ikhiywa lapha.
texts.ppl_sv_dl_help: Kanye nemibuzo namalebula. Akukaze kube ngubani ophendulile.
texts.ppl_sv_extra_note: Umdali ngamunye owengeziwe {creator} ngenyanga; izimpendulo ezingu-1,000 ezengeziwe {answers}.
texts.ppl_sv_field_help: Izimpendulo ozirekhodayo noma ozithayipha ephepheni zimakwa ngokuthi Kufakwe isisebenzi. Zihlala kudivayisi ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi futhi zithunyelwa kamuva.
texts.ppl_sv_fill_help: Uma iqembu ligcwele, abantu abasha abavela kulo bayabongwa futhi inhlolovo iyavalwa kubo.
texts.ppl_sv_free_note: Ku-LynkSurvey Free, izimpendulo ziyaqhubeka zifika kuze kuphele usuku umkhawulo ofinyelelwe ngalo.
texts.ppl_sv_in_my_answers: Ungabona noma usule izimpendulo zakho ku-Izimpendulo zami ku-akhawunti yakho ye-LynkOmni.
texts.ppl_sv_languages_help: Ibhalwa kanye, ibuzwe kuzo zonke izilimi ezingu-{n}, ngayo yonke indlela yokuphendula. Wonke umuntu uphendula ngolimi lwakhe.
texts.ppl_sv_logic_why: Buza umbuzo obhalwayo kuphela ngemuva kwempendulo engagculisekile
texts.ppl_sv_margin_help: Umphumela ngamunye ukhombisa ukuthi uqiniseke kangakanani. Imiphumela ivela kusukela ezimpendulweni ezingu-5.
texts.ppl_sv_need: Ukuze imiphumela ibe ngaphakathi kuka-±{m} %, udinga cishe izimpendulo ezingu-{n}.
texts.ppl_sv_panel_never: I-LynkOmni ithumela inhlolovo. Awukaze ubone ukuthi bangobani abantu.
texts.ppl_sv_phone_kept: Inombolo yakho isetshenziselwa le khodi kuphela futhi isulwa ngemuva kwezinsuku ezingu-30.
texts.ppl_sv_q_most: Yini ebaluleke kakhulu kuwe, futhi yini engabalulekile kangako?
texts.ppl_sv_q_tools: Unakho okudingayo ukuze wenze umsebenzi wakho kahle?
texts.ppl_sv_record_help: Isilungiselelo ngasinye, umgomo weqembu, ukukhetha kokulinganisa noshintsho kubhalwa ekhasini lendlela, ukuze abanye bethembe ucwaningo futhi baluphinde.
texts.ppl_sv_reward_help: Inhlangano ikhokha imiklomelo ngozakwethu wokukhokha onelayisensi. I-LynkOmni ayikaze ibambe umklomelo.
texts.ppl_sv_rule_invited_help: Wonke umuntu uthola ikhodi yakhe, esebenza kanye.
texts.ppl_sv_said_public: Kuboniswe ekhasini lomphakathi, ngoba inhlolovo ayidaluli muntu.
texts.ppl_sv_sample_sensitive: Kunjani ukunakekelwa kwempilo yakho kulo mtholampilo?
texts.ppl_sv_summary: {p} % bathi kuhle noma kuhle kakhulu, ngaphakathi kwamaphuzu angu-{m}, kuzimpendulo ezingu-{n}.
texts.ppl_sv_verified_help: Noma ubani angavula isixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa ukuze aqinisekise ukuthi izinombolo ziyiqiniso futhi azishintshile, kanye nerekhodi locwaningo.
texts.ppl_sv_version_help: Uma izimpendulo sezifikile, ushintsho lwenza inguqulo entsha, ukuze izimpendulo zemibuzo emidala nemisha zingaxubeki. Izimpendulo zokuhlola azibalwa nanini.
texts.ppl_sv_voice_note: Ifundwa ngezwi ngolimi lomuntu; uphendula ngezinkinobho noma ngezwi.
texts.ppl_sv_why_asked: Izimpendulo zakho zisiza inhlangano ithuthuke. Akukho okomuntu siqu okubuzwayo ngaphandle kwemvume yakho.
texts.ppl_sv_why_confirm_phone_first: Qala uqinisekise ikhodi ethunyelwe ocingweni lwakho.
texts.ppl_sv_why_free_limit_reached: Izimpendulo zamahhala zale nyanga ziphelile. Kudingeka uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_sv_why_invitation_needed: Le nhlolovo ingesimemo. Sebenzisa ikhodi oyitholile.
texts.ppl_sv_why_needs_approval_first: Le nhlolovo kufanele igunyazwe ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa.
texts.ppl_sv_why_one_reward_per_person: Umklomelo owodwa ngomuntu ngamunye enhlolovweni ngayinye.
texts.ppl_sv_why_only_after_the_check: Umklomelo unikezwa kuphela ngempendulo ephelele edlule ekuhlolweni.
texts.ppl_sv_why_plan_limit_live_surveys: Inani lezinhlolovo ezivuliwe zohlelo lwakho selifinyelelwe. Vala eyodwa noma ukhethe uhlelo olukhulu.
texts.ppl_sv_why_plan_no_hardware_without_disp: Izinto zekhompyutha ezingenasikrini zidinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_sv_why_plan_way: Le ndlela yokuphendula idinga uhlelo olukhokhelwayo.
texts.ppl_sv_why_sign_in_needed: Ngena nge-akhawunti yakho ye-LynkOmni ukuze uphendule.
texts.ppl_sv_write_note: Okusalungiswa okuvela emshweni wakho. Shintsha okuthandayo ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
texts.ppl_too_few: Imiphumela iboniswa kusukela ezimpendulweni ezingu-{n}, ukuze kungabikho muntu ohlonzwayo.
texts.ppl_works_offline: Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: le divayisi inezinombolo zayo zamathikithi.
texts.presentation_only: Kushintsha kuphela indlela okuboniswa ngayo izinto. Idatha yakho ihlala injalo.
texts.state_coming_soon_body: Le sevisi izovuleka ngokwayo uma kusayinwe uzakwethu onelayisensi ezweni lakho.
texts.state_error_body: Akukho okulahlekile. Zama futhi, noma ucele usizo.
texts.state_maintenance_body: Le ngxenye iyabuyekezwa. Ukuthengisa nakho konke okulondolozwe edivayisini yakho kuyaqhubeka nokusebenza.
texts.state_no_results_body: Zama amanye amagama noma izihlungi ezimbalwa.
texts.state_not_found_body: Ikheli kungenzeka lishintshile. Sesha into oyidingayo, noma uye ekhaya.
texts.state_offline_body: Qhubeka usebenza. Konke kulondolozwa kule divayisi futhi kuthunyelwe uma usuxhunyiwe futhi.
texts.state_permission_body: Cela umnikazi waleli bhizinisi ukuthi akunike le mvume.
texts.state_sync_pending_body: Izinguquko zakho zilondolozwe lapha futhi zizothunyelwa uma ukuxhumana sekubuyile.
texts.switch_side_group: Indawo yakho yokusebenza noma isitolo sakho se-inthanethi
texts.username_bad_character: Izinhlamvu a kuya ku-z, izinombolo, amachashazi nemigqa engezansi kuphela.
texts.username_held_for_review: Lokhu kubukeka njengegama eligodliwe futhi kuzobuyekezwa.
texts.username_hint: Izinhlamvu ezi-3 kuya ku-30: izinhlamvu, izinombolo, amachashazi nemigqa engezansi.
texts.username_leading_or_trailing_dot: Ichashazi alikwazi ukuba ngelokuqala noma ngelokugcina.
texts.username_rule: Kuboniswa njenge-@igama. Ngelakho kuze kube phakade; izixhumanisi ezindala ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza uma ulishintsha.
texts.view_owner_only: Ngumnikazi kuphela ongashintsha ukubukeka kwedivayisi yokuthengisa.
texts.view_waits: Ukubukeka okusha kuqala ngemuva kwalesi sinyathelo.
texts.weak_note: Ukuxhumana okubuthakathaka: idivayisi ithumela uma ikwazi. Ukuthengisa kuza kuqala.
texts.why_override: Ukhethe lokhu kubukeka kule divayisi. Khetha Okuzenzakalelayo ukuze ubuyele emuva.
texts.why_registered: Yile ndlela le divayisi ebhaliswe ngayo ebhizinisini.
texts.why_reported: Kukhethwe ngokwalokho okushiwo yidivayisi: isikrini sayo nendlela oyisebenzisa ngayo.
texts.why_safe_default: Le divayisi ayishongo okwanele, ngakho kusetshenziswa ukubukeka okusebenza nanoma iluphi uhlobo lokufaka.
texts.writes_in: U-{name} ubhala nge-{from}. Imilayezo ihunyushelwa ku-{to} ngenxa yakho.
